name: Lantern Harbor
pitch: Trade paper lanterns along a foggy dock; every sale lights up the shared skyline.

name: Moth & Flame
pitch: Secretly pick a lamp to circle; collide with a friend and you both singe a wing.

name: Saltmarsh Signals
pitch: Everyone helps a ferry crew cross the marsh by sharing clues without naming the cards.

name: Ironbark Court
pitch: Build a timber guild across four seasons; every worker you place blocks someone else's plan.

name: Copper Canyon Rail
pitch: Lay track through canyon towns and auction the last freight contracts.

name: Pocket Kraken
pitch: A card duel where each round you either feed the kraken or hide from it.

name: Midnight Bakers
pitch: Race to fill orders in a chaotic shared kitchen where the oven timer is a real sand glass.

name: Glasswing Heist
pitch: Two teams of thieves, one traitor each: who is lying about the vault code?

name: Tidewatch
pitch: Keep a lighthouse running as storm cards pile up; plays solo or together.

name: Spice Route Syndicate
pitch: Send caravans, corner a spice market, and bluff the tax collector.

name: Paper Kingdoms
pitch: Fold, tile and tuck a tiny kingdom into a six-by-six grid.

pitch: A campaign-style survival saga; your village's choices carry across sessions.

name: Echo Caverns
pitch: Hum a rhythm into the cave and hope your teammates echo the right one back.

name: Fox & Lantern
pitch: A woodland chase on a shifting maze board; the lantern decides who sees the walls.
